purpose: Create the Equipment page route/loader scaffold from the frozen Stage 4-0 frontend consumer contract. This stage establishes public routes, server-only consumer loading, exact equipmentId detail resolution, and public not-found behavior without implementing the final list/detail presentation UI.

implementation.routeNesting: Use the trailing-underscore non-nested file convention so the three Equipment routes are root-level siblings. /equipment is not a layout parent of exclusive/detail.
implementation.dataBoundary: Route modules call createServerFn wrappers. Raw generated JSON is imported only by the .server.ts module and is not directly imported by route components.
implementation.jsonModuleSupport: tsconfig compilerOptions.resolveJsonModule=true is required for typed static server-only JSON imports.

exclusive.ownerJoin: Each exclusive list record is enriched at read time with ownerHero from byEquipmentId -> hero-name-master exact heroId join.

detail.returns: general or exclusive detail payload, or null when the ID is not in the 373 public detail records
detail.hiddenHoldRule: soul-special 16 and equipmentId 2013 do not resolve because detail lookup is limited to the two public detail sets.

routeBehavior.general: Loads the 206 general list records and generated filter/tab metadata. 4-1 renders only a diagnostic scaffold; full list/filter UI is Stage 4-2.
routeBehavior.exclusive: Loads the 167 exclusive list records with canonical owner Hero metadata. 4-1 renders only a diagnostic scaffold; full exclusive UI is Stage 4-4.
routeBehavior.detail: Parses the URL equipmentId as a positive integer, loads from public detail sources, and throws TanStack Router notFound() when the ID is invalid or not public.

hardGates: General loader exposes exactly 206 records and tab counts 94/80/32 from the Stage 3 generated consumer.
Exclusive loader exposes exactly 167 records and every record resolves exactly one canonical owner Hero through the accepted byEquipmentId index.
Public detail lookup contains exactly 373 unique IDs = 206 general + 167 exclusive and the sets are disjoint.
soul-special 16 and equipmentId 2013 are absent from public detail resolution.
No route or server-function code reads data/configdata or ConfigDataEquipmentInfo directly.
No Stage 4 code re-derives exclusive ownership from SkillHero, names, restrictions, icons, sort order, or release chronology.
TanStack Start build succeeds with the new file routes and server functions.
nonGoals: Reopening Stage 2/3 semantics or Stage B ownership

completion.meaning: All three public Equipment routes exist as independent file routes, load only frozen consumer sources through server functions, enforce public detail admission by exact equipmentId, and are ready for Stage 4-2 UI implementation.
